summary: Jurisdiction under SARFAESI Act; civil court jurisdiction not ousted for title disputes; Section 34 SARFAESI Act interpreted; validity of sale deed and mortgage affecting title; DRT lacks power to decide title; civil court competent to adjudicate; court fee properly paid; plaint rejection under Order VII Rule 11 CPC set aside; High Court judgment upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 Order VII Rule 11
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment affirmed; civil suit restored.
